msgs:
DO SOMETHING TODAY
YOUR FUTURE SELF
WILL THANK YOU FOR

YOU CAN DO
MORE THAN
YOU THINK

Step by step
to the goal

Don't wait for
the perfect moment

One day or
day one?
You decide

Do what you can
with what
you have

Falling isn't scary.
Not getting up is

No elevator to
success. Take
the stairs

A goal without
a plan is
just a wish

Plan for today:
one important thing

Every expert was
once a beginner

Mountains are
climbed step
by step

Think about what
you can change

Don't wait for
motivation. Act,
and it will come

Rest is part
of the plan

A good day
for a win

It won't be easy.
It will be
worth it

Dreams don't work
unless you do

Impossible is
just not done yet

You're not alone.
We believe in you

Change your thoughts,
change your life

Champions train
when no one
is watching

A smile is half
the success

Step out of your
comfort zone

Where there's a will,
there's a way

You already did
the hard part:
you started

Doubts are no
reason to stop

Don't look back.
You're not
going that way

The road is
conquered by
walking it

The best is
yet to come

No bad weather
for good deeds

Break big tasks
into small ones

Time passes anyway.
Use it well

Believe you can
and you're halfway
there

Every day is
a new chance

Even a small step
is movement

Willpower is a
muscle. Train it

Don't put it
off till tomorrow

Look back and see
how far you came

Winners are
those who
don't give up

Your pace is
the right pace

The more you do,
the more you can

Go forward with
a light heart

Be more stubborn
than your problems

Life is not
a race. It's
a journey

You do more than
you notice

Every breakthrough
starts with
a try

Show up.
That's half of it

Be the energy
you want to see

Hard work
beats talent
that doesn't work

One more rep,
one more page

Goals in pencil,
effort in ink

Keep calm and
carry on working
